Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2021 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AON.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $4.93 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 146 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2021.
We delivered record revenue of $24.6 billion this quarter, representing 22% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 22% to 18% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Could you quantify the FX headwind embedded in your guidance?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $24.6 billion this quarter, representing 22% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
